nyheter.title: Navy’s Shipbuilding Plan Would Exceed Budget Estimates by Hundreds of Billions, CBO Finds
nyheter.summary: Increasing the size of the Navy’s fleet by 112 ships over the next three decades would require a 41 percent increase in the sea service’s annual budget and exceed the Navy’s own budget estimates by about 18 percent – a total delta of some $234 billion.  That’s according to a new analysis from the Congressional Budget Office, released Wednesday. nyheter.title: Pearl Harbor Hero Doris Miller Will Stay Namesake of CVN-81
nyheter.summary: The future aircraft carrier CVN-81 will keep its name of USS Doris Miller, USNI News has learned. HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding will lay the ceremonial keel for the future Doris Miller on Dec. 5, according to an invitation to the ceremony reviewed by USNI News. The ship is named after the enlisted sailor who received the Navy Cross for his heroics during the attack on Pearl Harbor. nyheter.title: Navy’s shipbuilding plan would require massive hike in annual appropriations: CBO
nyheter.summary: The Navy’s shipbuilding plan released in May would average out to an annual cost of roughly $53.8 billion in shipbuilding appropriations — a 41 percent increase from the last five years, the Congressional Budget Office found.

nyheter.title: U.S., Philippine Marines Set Up Surveillance Radar in Palawan
nyheter.summary: MANILA, Philippines — U.S. and Philippine Marines set up coastal surveillance radar on a beach facing the South China Sea during a maritime strike targeting drill earlier this month. Marines with Marine Rotational Force-Southeast Asia practiced deploying a Ground Based Maritime Systems-Light system in Aporawan, Palawan, with their Philippine counterparts on Nov. 5. nyheter.title: U.S. Expands Iranian Blockade As Ship Attacks Continue
nyheter.summary: The U.S. expanded its blockade of Iranian ports and coastline to include any ship that receives cargo via ship-to-ship transfer, according to Joint Maritime Information Center. Any ship that receives cargo via ship-to-ship transfer from a ship that loaded at an Iranian port or coastline could be considered as attempting to evade the U.S.’s blockade, reads the JMIC advisory. nyheter.summary: Two Navy F-35C Lightning II fighters have completed the jet’s first round of launch and recovery testing aboard the future USS John F. Kennedy.

nyheter.summary: Lawmakers are pushing back on the Navy’s shipbuilding plans by cutting funding for several high-profile programs and reducing the shipbuilding budget by nearly $20 billion. rov_teknologi.summary: USS George Washington (CVN-73) left the Middle East after being on station for three months, a U.S. Pacific Fleet spokesperson confirmed Wednesday to USNI News.  George Washington is now in U.S. 7th Fleet. The spokesperson did not provide additional details, including which of George Washington’s escorts accompanied the ship.
